resources.string: Tap the preview to focus. Pinch to zoom; double tap resets zoom.
Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
Stop broadcasting before changing the relay, codec or audio input.
Could not apply the requested resolution and frame rate. The previous setting is being restored.
Dropped video frames in the last sample: %1$d
High app CPU use is accompanying low encoder frame rate.
Verified %1$d decoded video frames on this device
The broadcast notification has an immediate stop action.
Choose the relay server and broadcast path.
Added as a jwt query parameter when broadcasting starts.
Save and reuse video and audio settings. Presets are checked against the available hardware encoder before applying.
Enter a preset name from 1 to 64 characters.
The preset could not be saved. Try again.
This quality preset contains invalid video or audio settings.
Hardware encoder: %1$s · width %2$s · height %3$s · FPS %4$s · bitrate %5$s · CBR %6$s. Runtime bitrate changes are confirmed when the encoder is running.
No hardware surface encoder was reported for this codec. The final result is still confirmed when MediaCodec is configured.
Starts at the target and adapts within your minimum and maximum.
Keeps the configured encoder target without reducing it based on bandwidth estimates.
Control microphone capture, channels and volume gain.
Manage the access token and TLS certificate verification.
Capture microphone audio and encode it with Opus at 48 kHz.
Stereo automatically falls back to mono if the microphone format is unavailable.
100% keeps the original volume. 0% mutes audio; higher values amplify it, up to 300%.
Stereo capture is unavailable on this device. This broadcast is using mono.
Validate the relay certificate and hostname.
Allow self-signed certificates for local development.
This camera and resolution support up to %1$d FPS. Try a lower resolution or switch cameras.
Camera permission is required to preview and broadcast video. Microphone permission is requested only when audio is enabled.
Microphone permission is required when broadcast audio is enabled. Grant access or turn off broadcast audio.
Could not start the camera. Check camera access or try another camera or resolution. Details are saved in diagnostics.
Enter a valid relay URL, such as https://relay.example.com.
Enter a broadcast path without spaces.
Set minimum ≤ target ≤ maximum, with each value between 100 and 2147483.647 Kbps.
The encoder rejected a bitrate change. The last rate accepted by the encoder is still in use.
The encoder is starting or reconnecting. Apply the bitrate settings once video resumes.
Could not connect or publish to the relay. Check the server URL, path, authentication, TLS and network. Details are saved in diagnostics.
Video encoding or transmission failed. Try a lower resolution or frame rate. Details are saved in diagnostics.
Could not capture or encode microphone audio. Check microphone access or try mono. Details are saved in diagnostics.
Could not start the %1$s hardware encoder at %2$d×%3$d, %4$d FPS. See Diagnostics for the startup error.
Attach this ZIP to the conversation. You can share it now or save it to your device first.
Diagnostics saved. You can attach the ZIP to the conversation.
Could not save diagnostics. Please try again.
Could not create diagnostics. Check device storage and try again.
Could not open sharing. Use Save file instead.
Checks GitHub Releases for a signed MoQ Publisher APK. Downloads are verified with SHA-256 before installation.
Install App updates through the original distribution channel.
A newer app version is available.
The verified APK is ready to install.
The installed app is up to date.
The app update could not be checked or downloaded. Try again later.
Stop broadcasting before downloading or installing an app update.
No Android package installer is available for this APK.
The downloaded app update is missing. Download it again.
The downloaded app update could not be verified. Download it again.
This update is not MoQ Publisher and cannot be installed.
This update is signed differently and cannot replace the installed app.
Allow MoQ Publisher to install unknown apps in system settings, then install the update.
This update does not support the current Android version.
The update version does not match. Check for updates and download again.
App %1$s is available. Download it now?
App %1$s is downloaded and ready to install.
MoQ core %1$s is ready and will apply on the next app start.
MoQ core %1$s has been released. Compatibility checks and download will resume after the broadcast ends.
MoQ core %1$s has been released and requires an app update first. The compatible core remains in use.
Stream quality is reduced. Monitoring the media pipeline.
The stream media pipeline may be stalled. Check diagnostics.
Published FPS is below the target.
Thermal or memory pressure is detected. Lowering the bitrate can protect stream continuity.
MoQ Publisher version, app updates and the downloaded MoQ core.
Downloaded directly from official MoQ releases on Maven Central. Saved across APK updates; checks for compatible updates at startup.
The core could not be downloaded or verified. Check your internet connection and retry.
Core updates will resume after the broadcast ends.
The latest compatible core is ready.
Update check unavailable. Your saved core is ready for use.
Official version %1$s requires different app bindings. Continuing with the latest compatible core.
Version %1$s is saved and will be used the next time the app starts.
Download the MoQ core before starting a broadcast.
Adjust image brightness. The supported range depends on the selected camera.
This camera does not support exposure compensation.
Keep the interface horizontal. Both landscape directions are supported.
Keep broadcasting when switching apps or turning off the screen. Use the broadcast notification to stop.
Sets the actual Opus bitrate. Higher quality uses more bandwidth. Mono fallback adjusts the bitrate automatically.
Select a built-in, wired, USB or Bluetooth microphone. If it is removed during a broadcast, the app falls back to the system route.
Broadcasting camera and enabled audio. Tap to return to the app.
Audio muted. Tap to return to the app.
Could not start the broadcast service. Return to the app and check camera and microphone access, then try again.
The previous broadcast is finishing. Please try again in a moment.
Publishes Hang media using Cloudflare MoQ Draft 18.
Enter a Cloudflare Publish + Subscribe connection token. It is stored with Android Keystore encryption and sent in the URL path.
Use a separate Subscribe-only token for watching, OBS and receiver verification. Never use a Publish token here.
Leave blank to publish an unnamed broadcast. Use a .hang name for a moq.watch link.
Do not enter a Cloudflare Management API Token. No Relay ID or moq.pro Project ID is needed.
A viewing link contains the Subscribe Token. Anyone with the link can subscribe within its permissions until it expires or is revoked.
The moq.watch link requires a separate Subscribe-only token and a .hang name.
QR code for the viewing URL
Scan this code on a viewing device. The code contains the Subscribe token and should be shared only with trusted viewers.

In OBS, add a Browser Source and open this URL.
%1$s
Set the source size to the published video dimensions, then verify audio in OBS. The URL contains the Subscribe token.

Use an OBS source that supports MoQ Draft 18 and the Hang catalog.
Subscribe URL: %1$s Broadcast: %2$s
In OBS, check the video preview and Opus audio meter.
Confirm that this token has only Subscribe permission. Cloudflare tokens are opaque: the app cannot infer their permissions. The viewing URL and OBS info include this token.
Cloudflare always verifies TLS certificates. Connection tokens are encrypted with Android Keystore and excluded from backup.
Could not securely load or save the connection token. Re-enter it; if the error persists, restart the app. No plaintext fallback is used.
Enter a Cloudflare Publish + Subscribe connection token, without a URL, Bearer prefix or query parameters.
This Cloudflare profile requires MoQ Transport Draft 18.
Leave the broadcast name blank for an unnamed publication, or enter a valid Cloudflare namespace path without empty segments, spaces, query parameters or relative path segments.
Cloudflare Draft 18 connection failed. Check the connection token, relay permissions, network and compatible core. A connected session alone does not verify Hang publication.
Relay rejected authentication or permissions. Check that the connection token is valid, unexpired and permits the required operation.
Relay protocol failure: %1$s / %2$s (code %3$s). This operation was not accepted; media delivery is unverified. See the exported diagnostics.
Relay connection timed out. Check the endpoint, network and QUIC availability, then try again.
Relay reconnected. Waiting for a fresh keyframe.
The camera is active, but the GPU has stopped submitting frames to the encoder.
The microphone is active, but audio publication has stalled.
The app could not recover the stream.
Connected; waiting for a subscriber to request the video track.
Endpoint: Draft %1$d. Negotiated draft is not exposed by SDK 0.5.3.

Start broadcasting first. This opens a separate remote Subscribe session for up to 30 seconds and decodes video and enabled audio. It uses extra data and does not verify a separate browser or OBS client.
Use a separate viewing JWT for a private relay. Public relays can use an empty field.
Enter a secure relay URL and a viewing JWT that differs from the publish JWT.
Open a viewing page compatible with the relay in OBS Browser Source. Enter the subscribe endpoint and broadcast name in that player, then check video and audio in OBS.
Use an OBS source that supports the relay protocol and Hang catalog. Enter the subscribe endpoint and broadcast name, then check video and Opus audio in OBS.
Waiting for the remote broadcast and media catalog
Waiting for a video keyframe from the relay
Remote decode passed: %1$s, %2$d × %3$d; decoded frames: %4$d; %5$s. Browser playback still needs checking.
Could not connect to the relay with the Subscribe Token. Check the network and relay.
The relay rejected Subscribe authentication. Check the token, expiry and permissions.
The remote media catalog did not arrive. Check the broadcast name and token scope.
The relay video track could not be subscribed to.
The relay did not deliver a decodable starting keyframe.
Video arrived, but the Android decoder could not produce frames.
Could not receive and decode the remote Opus audio.
The remote video codec or dimensions cannot be verified by this device decoder.
